questions.text: How many commandments did Moses receive from God?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: 10.

questions.text: In the Bible, who built an ark to survive the great flood?
In the Bible, which young shepherd defeated the giant Goliath?
What is the title of the leader of the Catholic Church?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Santo Papa, Bishop of Rome, Holy Father.

questions.text: In the Bible, what was the name of the garden where Adam and Eve lived?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Garden of Eden, Paraiso.

questions.text: What is the first book of the Bible?
What string of prayer beads do Catholics use to pray to the Virgin Mary?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: rosaryo.

questions.text: What series of Masses do Filipino Catholics attend in the nine days before Christmas?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Misa de Gallo, Misa de Aguinaldo.

questions.text: Cebu's Sinulog festival honors what image of the child Jesus?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Santo Nino, Señor Santo Niño, Holy Child.

questions.text: Millions join the Traslacion in Quiapo every January 9 to honor what image?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Poong Nazareno, Nuestro Padre Jesús Nazareno, Nazareno.

questions.text: During which week do Filipino Catholics traditionally go on Visita Iglesia?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Semana Santa, Mahal na Araw.

questions.text: What is the 40-day Christian season of fasting and prayer before Easter?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Kuwaresma, Cuaresma.

questions.text: What is the holy book of Islam?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Koran, Qur'an.

questions.text: During which Islamic month do Muslims fast from dawn to sunset?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Ramadhan.

questions.text: In the Bible, which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Jonas.

questions.text: According to the Gospels, in which town was Jesus born?
questions.hostNotes: Not Nazareth, where he grew up.

questions.text: At the wedding at Cana, what did Jesus turn water into?
questions.hostNotes: It is described as his first public miracle.

questions.text: Which apostle denied knowing Jesus three times?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Simon Peter, San Pedro. Not Judas, who betrayed him.

questions.text: Which archangel told Mary she would bear the Son of God?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: San Gabriel. The event is called the Annunciation.

questions.text: In Islam, who is regarded as the final prophet?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Mohammed, Prophet Muhammad.

questions.text: What was the birth name of the Buddha?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Siddhartha, Gautama.

questions.text: What is the pilgrimage to Mecca that every able Muslim must make at least once?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Haj. A man who has completed it is called a Hajji.

questions.text: What name is given to the first five books of the Hebrew Bible?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pentateuch.

questions.text: What Hindu festival of lights celebrates the victory of light over darkness?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Deepavali.

questions.text: Who was the first Filipino saint, canonized in 1987?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: San Lorenzo Ruiz. Not Pedro Calungsod, the second, canonized in 2012.

questions.text: Which church was founded in the Philippines by Felix Manalo in 1914?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: INC.

questions.text: What Easter dawn rite reenacts the meeting of the Risen Christ and his mother?
What Muslim holiday, also a Philippine national holiday, marks the end of the month of fasting?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Eid'l Fitr, Eid ul-Fitr, Hari Raya Puasa. Not Eid al-Adha.

questions.text: Which river do Hindus consider the most sacred?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Ganga.

questions.text: The Dalai Lama is the spiritual leader of which branch of Buddhism?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Tibetan, Vajrayana, Gelug (his school).

questions.text: How many times a day are Muslims required to pray?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: 5. The daily prayer is called salah or salat.

questions.text: Which Hindu god has the head of an elephant?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Ganesh, Ganapati.

questions.text: In Buddhism, what is the state of final freedom from suffering and rebirth called?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Nibbana.

questions.text: What Hebrew word, sung in praise especially at Easter, means "praise the Lord"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Alleluia, Aleluya.

questions.text: Which apostle doubted the Resurrection until he saw Jesus's wounds?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Doubting Thomas, Santo Tomas.

questions.text: What is the Jewish coming-of-age ceremony for a 13-year-old boy called?
questions.hostNotes: For girls it is the bat mitzvah.

questions.text: What eight-day Jewish holiday is celebrated by lighting a menorah?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Chanukah, Festival of Lights.

questions.text: What Hindu scripture records a dialogue between Krishna and the warrior Arjuna?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Gita. It is part of the epic Mahabharata.

questions.text: What is the Filipino Lenten tradition of chanting the life and passion of Christ called?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pasyon, Pabasa ng Pasyon.

questions.text: What Filipino Christmas Eve pageant reenacts Mary and Joseph searching for a place to stay?
Under what title of the Virgin Mary is she the principal patroness of the Philippines?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, Inmaculada Concepción. Declared by Pope Pius XII in 1942.

questions.text: What Intramuros church, finished in 1607, is the oldest stone church still standing in the Philippines?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: San Agustin, Church of St. Augustine. Not Manila Cathedral.

questions.text: Which pope celebrated the closing Mass of World Youth Day in Manila in 1995?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: John Paul II, St. John Paul II.

questions.text: Which teenage Visayan catechist, martyred in Guam in 1672, was canonized in 2012?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: San Pedro Calungsod.

questions.text: The oldest mosque in the Philippines, built in 1380, is in which province?
questions.hostNotes: The Sheik Karimul Makhdum Mosque in Simunul.
